name: Shrikant Pawade
tagline: AI engineer in Pune. I train small language models and build the tools around them.
intro: I build with AI: an MCP server that diagnoses failed CI runs, a reconciliation tool for accountants, and small language models fine-tuned on my own data. Every model here ships with an evaluation, because a model you can't score is one you can't trust.
description: Shrikant Pawade, an AI engineer in Pune. Projects, essays and notes on training small language models.
